# Packages whose version can change the numbers in the committed chains under
# data/, rather than only whether the code runs.
#
# The sessions load those chains instead of regenerating them, because a full
# PMMH run takes hours. So the site render shows a bump broke no code path, and
# shows nothing about whether the sampler still produces the committed draws.
# One workflow reads this list: compathelper_automerge.yml keeps a bump to any
# of these off auto-merge, so a person decides whether to widen the bound.
#
# That is the whole of what this list does today. Nothing checks the chains
# themselves against the versions that produced them, and a widened bound is
# only the permission for a later move: the version the code loads is the one
# pinned in Manifest.toml, which a widened bound leaves valid, so Pkg.resolve
# keeps it until someone re-resolves. Catching that move needs a check that
# compares the manifest, which is not in place.
#
# One bare name per line, nothing else on the line: the reader matches the whole
# line with grep -qxF. Every name is a direct dependency in Project.toml, which
# is the right universe here because the guard reads a CompatHelper title and
# CompatHelper only bumps direct dependencies. Each earns its place by sitting
# on the path the generation scripts take:
#
#   Turing                 drives the sampler
#   AdvancedMH             RobustAdaptiveMetropolis, the proposal itself
#   SSMProblems            the state space model interface
#   GeneralisedFilters     BF, the bootstrap filter the chains run through
#   LogExpFunctions        GeneralisedFilters' log-weight arithmetic
#   StatsBase              GeneralisedFilters' resampler
#   JumpProcesses          the stochastic simulator
#   DifferentialEquations  supplies the solve both simulators run through, and
#                          the ODE behind the committed deck figures
#   Distributions          the priors and the observation model
#
# LogExpFunctions and StatsBase earn their place through what GeneralisedFilters
# does with them, not through anything here: `logsumexp` is called only by
# src/threaded_bootstrap_filter.jl, `wsample` is imported and never called, and
# the chains take the unthreaded BF path. So do not prune either on a grep of
# src/, which is what that evidence looks like at first glance.
#
# AdvancedVI is deliberately absent: nothing committed under data/ comes from it.

Turing
AdvancedMH
SSMProblems
GeneralisedFilters
LogExpFunctions
StatsBase
DifferentialEquations
JumpProcesses
Distributions
